_about: Alfred Sidgwick (1850-1943), English logician of the pragmatist side, cousin of Henry Sidgwick (shelf henry-sidgwick). Raw IA OCR: Fallacies, a view of logic from the practical side (Kegan Paul, International Scientific Series, 1885); Distinction and the Criticism of Beliefs (Longmans, 1892); Elementary Logic (Cambridge, 1914). He died in 1943, but every book here was published before 1930, so US public domain. No uids minted.
